requests.title: NPSB transfers debited but beneficiary not credited since yesterday EOD
requests.description: Dear Sir, several of our customers reported that NPSB transfers done through internet banking were debited from their accounts but the receiving bank says nothing was credited. The status in the portal shows TIMEOUT with code NPSB-TO-504. Customers are queuing at the counter asking for refund. Kindly check if the auto-reversal job is running. About 14 transactions so far, list attached.
requests.environment: Live server, branch PC Windows 10, Chrome
requests.steps_to_reproduce:
1. Login as customer in internet banking
2. Fund Transfer > NPSB, enter beneficiary of other bank and amount
3. Confirm with OTP
requests.expected_result: Transfer completes, or if it fails the amount is reversed immediately.
requests.actual_result: Amount debited, status TIMEOUT NPSB-TO-504, no credit at beneficiary bank and no reversal after 24 hours.
